description: This file manages trusted safe binary directories, including normalization, resolution, caching, and permission checks, primarily for security purposes in a Node.js environment.

classes.name: WritableTrustedSafeBinDir
classes.description: Represents a directory with its write permissions status for group and others.

methods.name: normalizeTrustedDir
methods.description: Trims and resolves a directory path to an absolute path, or returns null if input is empty.

methods.name: normalizeTrustedSafeBinDirs
methods.description: Normalizes an array of directory strings by trimming and removing duplicates.

methods.name: resolveTrustedSafeBinDirs
methods.description: Resolves directory paths to absolute paths and sorts them uniquely.

methods.name: buildTrustedSafeBinCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key string from a list of directory entries.

methods.name: buildTrustedSafeBinDirs
methods.description: Builds a set of trusted safe binary directories from base and extra directories.

methods.name: getTrustedSafeBinDirs
methods.description: Retrieves cached trusted directories or rebuilds them if cache is invalid or refresh is requested.

methods.name: isTrustedSafeBinPath
methods.description: Checks if a given path is within the trusted safe binary directories.

methods.name: listWritableExplicitTrustedSafeBinDirs
methods.description: Lists directories with explicit write permissions, excluding non-directories and non-writable directories.
